query_analysis.original_query: We're looking to optimize the design of our pressure leaf filter. What experimental approaches can we use to characterize the filtration performance across different particle size distributions?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and recommend experimental techniques to assess and characterize the filtration performance of pressure leaf filters across varying particle size distributions, to enhance and optimize the filter design.

selected_agents.role: Lead the identification of experimental approaches for filtration performance characterization
Assist with data analysis and interpretation from experimental results
Integrate experimental findings into filter design optimization

communication_strategy.information_flow: Transfer of experimental approaches and data analysis to optimize filter design
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative experimental design and performance evaluation

clarification_questions: What is the range of particle sizes you are dealing with?
Are there any specific materials or properties of the particles that we should consider?
What are your current filtration performance metrics or targets?
Do you have any constraints on the experimental methods, such as equipment availability, budget, or time?
